chunks: Sa'd ibn Abd Allah narrated from Abu Ja'far, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz ibn Abd Allah, from Abu Basir and Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), said: 'People are ruined in their bellies and their private parts because they did not pay us our right. Behold, our Shias are exempt from that, and their ancestors are in a state of freedom (exemption).'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Imams' right regarding people's bellies and private parts?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates from Imam Ali (peace be upon him) that people are ruined due to their failure to pay the 'right' of the Imams, which relates to their consumption and sexual desires. However, the Shias (and their ancestors) are exempt from this ruin.
